newsitem.title: USA: Duke Pwr unit chosen for Calif. ISO systems.
newsitem.headline: Duke Pwr unit chosen for Calif. ISO systems.

text.p: Duke Power Co's Duke Engineering & Services (DE&S) announced Tuesday it was awarded a contract to develop and implement California's planned independent transmission system operator (ISO).

The ISO, charged with managing California's transmission system and ensuring its reliability, is scheduled for implementation by January 1998 when the state plans to begin its electricity market for open competition.

WEPEX, a state-sanctioned consortium of California investor-owned utilities including Edison International's Southern California Edison Co, PG&E Corp's Pacific Gas & Electric Co and Enova Corp's San Diego Gas & Electric Co, selected DE&S to provide management and other services.
DE&S will be responsible for implementation of systems including energy management, communications, revenue meter data acquisition, scheduling infrastructure and applications.
Eduardo Sugay of DE&S is project manager for the ISO contract.
